name: opentelemetry
description: OpenTelemetry for server applications: OTLP export to a collector configured only by standard OTEL_* environment variables, W3C propagation across every process boundary, three span tiers with class-level service and repository spans, default service metrics, the pipeline log appender with trace correlation, background jobs as linked root spans, serverless flush, and verification against an in-memory exporter and a real collector.
